You now have a way of approaching your own writing that will serve you in every assignment from here on. Each time you match a field's conventions, work them out from what you read, or use a source to serve your own argument, you are doing the work this course named. The habit to keep is simple: read how your subject writes, and write towards it.

That same habit carries into professional and research writing. Wherever you write for a field, the people whose work is trusted are the ones who write as insiders, with judgement that is visibly their own. The way of writing you have just learned to see is one you will use long after you graduate.
